verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking and financial-infrastructure API platform, and it mentions 'flows to automate lending and repayments', so asking about automation management is a fair axis. However, the evidence never documents versioning, review, or rollback of user-defined automations. The API deprecation policy covers vendor endpoint lifecycle, not customer automations, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
